headline: Michael Carrick: Man United cannot let VAR error have 'impact' on rest of season
description: Michael Carrick has warned his Manchester United players last weekend's VAR controversy in their derby defeat to rivals City cannot become a pivotal moment in their season.

headline: Tottenham's horror start continues with home loss to Villa
description: Aston Villa heap pressure on Roberto De Zerbi's big-spending and still winless Spurs with a 3-2 victory at Tottenham Hotspur stadium.

headline: Brighton shatter Arsenal's perfect start
description: Brighton shock Mikel Arteta's dumbstruck side 3-0 to end Arsenal's 100% start to their EPL title defense in stunning fashion.

headline: Frank Lampard values Coventry's hard work after first Premier League win in 25 years
description: Frank Lampard said he was grateful for his team's work ethic after Coventry ended a four-game losing streak to claim their first Premier League win for 25 years.
